mapper.select: SELECT * FROM yan_article_search_outbox WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND next_retry_at <= NOW(3) ORDER BY id LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.update: UPDATE yan_article_search_outbox SET status = 'PROCESSING', locked_until = DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL #{leaseSeconds} SECOND), update_time = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PENDING' AND next_retry_at <= NOW(3)
UPDATE yan_article_search_outbox SET status = 'SUCCEEDED', locked_until = NULL, last_error = NULL, update_time = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING'

UPDATE yan_article_search_outbox SET status = 'PENDING', retry_count = retry_count + 1, next_retry_at = DATE_ADD(NOW(3), INTERVAL #{delaySeconds} SECOND), locked_until = NULL, last_error = #{lastError}, update_time = NOW(3) WHERE id = #{id} AND status = 'PROCESSING'
UPDATE yan_article_search_outbox SET status = 'PENDING', locked_until = NULL, update_time = NOW(3) WHERE status = 'PROCESSING' AND locked_until < NOW(3)
UPDATE yan_article_search_outbox SET next_retry_at = NOW(3), last_error = NULL, update_time = NOW(3) WHERE status = 'PENDING'
